findings.title: Toxic flow: untrusted input can reach an external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: research.answer, page.summarize, web.search, page.extract · Public sink: web.search · Destructive: research.answer.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: research.answer, page.summarize, web.search, page.extract · Public sink: web.search · Destructive: research.answer

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
